scams.description: Taxi drivers claim meter is broken and quote 5-10x normal fare
scams.howToAvoid: Use Uber/Ola or prepaid taxi booth at airport. If meter is 'broken', get out and find another taxi.
scams.fairPrice: Airport to city center: ₹400-600 by prepaid, ₹300-400 by Uber/Ola

scams.description: People approach you near monuments claiming to be official guides
scams.howToAvoid: Only hire guides wearing official badges from Archaeological Survey of India. Better yet, use audio guides or read online.

scams.description: Driver takes you to 'government approved' shops and gets 40% commission
scams.howToAvoid: Never go to shops recommended by drivers. Research shops online first. Government doesn't certify private shops.

scams.description: Touts tell you monument is closed and offer alternative tour
scams.howToAvoid: Verify on official website or call monument directly. Most scammers say this on days monuments are actually open.

scams.description: Touts sell tickets at inflated prices or fake tickets
scams.howToAvoid: Buy tickets only at official ASI counter or online at https://asi.payumoney.com

scams.description: Shops claim to sell 'same marble as Taj Mahal' - usually low quality or fake
scams.howToAvoid: Don't buy marble products unless you're an expert. Most are overpriced and not authentic.

scams.description: Someone offers to take your photo then demands money
scams.howToAvoid: Politely decline photo offers. Use selfie stick or ask another tourist.

scams.description: Shop owners claim you can buy gems cheap and resell in your country for profit. They may ship fake gems or nothing at all.
scams.howToAvoid: Never fall for 'export business' schemes. If it sounds too good to be true, it is.

scams.description: Unauthorized guides charge excessive fees and give incorrect information
scams.howToAvoid: Hire guides at official counter or use audio guide. Negotiate price upfront.

scams.description: Auto drivers get 30-40% commission from certain restaurants
scams.howToAvoid: Choose your own restaurant. Walk away if driver insists on specific place.

scams.description: Driver claims you need to pay toll/parking in addition to prepaid ticket
scams.howToAvoid: Prepaid ticket includes all charges. Don't pay anything extra except small tip if you want.

scams.description: Auto drivers refuse to go by meter, quote high flat rates
scams.howToAvoid: Insist on meter or use Uber/Ola. It's illegal to refuse meter. You can complain: 1800-2674774

scams.description: Shop starts at 10x reasonable price
scams.howToAvoid: Start bargaining at 30-40% of quoted price. Walk away if they won't budge.
scams.fairPrice: Expect to pay 40-50% of initial asking price

scams.description: Goa taxis have fixed high prices and refuse to negotiate
scams.howToAvoid: Rent a scooter (₹300-500/day) or use GoaMiles app. Uber/Ola are limited.
scams.fairPrice: Taxi Dabolim Airport to North Goa: ₹1200-1500 (very expensive)

scams.description: No clear menu, final bill is much higher than discussed
scams.howToAvoid: Get itemized written quote before starting. Clarify all inclusions.

scams.description: Dealer sells drugs then tips off police for bribe
scams.howToAvoid: Just say no. Goa has strict drug laws. This is a common scam.

scams.description: Boatmen quote ₹1500-2000 for sunrise boat ride
scams.howToAvoid: Walk to Assi Ghat, negotiate with multiple boatmen. Book through hotel if possible.

scams.description: Driver/guide gets huge commission from silk shops
scams.howToAvoid: If buying silk, research shops online first. Don't trust driver recommendations.

scams.description: Asks for 'suggested donation' of ₹5000-10000
scams.howToAvoid: Politely decline blessings at ghats. If you want blessing, donate what you wish (₹50-100 is plenty).

scams.description: Some courses have unqualified teachers and poor facilities despite high prices
scams.howToAvoid: Research courses thoroughly online (reviews). Visit school before paying full amount.
scams.fairPrice: Varies - ₹300-1000/day for quality course with accommodation

scams.description: Some operators don't include transport or photo CD in quoted price
scams.howToAvoid: Clarify what's included: equipment, transport, photos, insurance. Get written confirmation.

scams.description: Final bill includes 'additional charges' not discussed
scams.howToAvoid: Book through reputable operator. Get detailed written itinerary with all-inclusive price.
scams.fairPrice: ₹8000-15000 per night for 2-person boat (all meals, AC/non-AC)

scams.description: Unqualified practitioners, poor quality treatments
scams.howToAvoid: Visit only government-approved centers or reputable resorts. Check certifications.

scams.description: Driver takes you to overpriced miniature painting shops
scams.howToAvoid: Choose shops yourself. Old City has many good shops - compare prices.

scams.description: Private boat owners quote ₹2000-3000
scams.howToAvoid: Use official boat from City Palace jetty. Fixed rates, better boats.
scams.fairPrice: ₹400-500 per person for 1-hour sunset cruise (official boat)

scams.description: Cheap packages have poor vehicles, inexperienced drivers, bad hotels
scams.howToAvoid: Don't choose cheapest option. Research operator reviews. Roads are dangerous - need good driver.
scams.fairPrice: 6-7 day package: ₹35,000-50,000 per person (quality operator, includes permits)

scams.description: Pharmacy may overcharge tourists for Diamox
scams.howToAvoid: Buy Diamox before arriving in Leh. Generic acetazolamide is cheap.

scams.description: Rigged meters run faster than actual distance
scams.howToAvoid: Use Uber/Ola/Rapido. If auto, check if meter looks old/damaged. Insist on meter.

scams.description: Taxi drivers quote ₹3000-4000 for half-day trip
scams.howToAvoid: Book through Ola Outstation or rent self-drive car. Negotiate hard.
scams.fairPrice: ₹1500-2000 for half-day to Nandi Hills (60km each way)
